question: Which deities are associated with the root, middle, and tip of the kūrca?
premises: Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Īśvara are named.
They are located at the root, middle, and tip of the kūrca.
inference: Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Īśvara are regarded as presiding over the root, middle, and tip of the kūrca.
plain_english: Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Īśvara are regarded as situated at the root, middle, and tip of the kūrca.
